posts.description: ZSvirt landed on my radar the way a lot of virtualization projects do: vendors raising prices, license changes forcing rearchitecture, and teams looking for a way out without rewriting their whole stack. posts.title: RHEL Disk Order Problem on VMware vSphere
posts.description: I've been running RHEL on VMware vSphere since ESXi 5.5 in my lab—nested labs, customer environments, production clusters.
